attributes.action: Justice for Willy Mcginley – Give His Family the Respect They Deserve.
attributes.additional_details: Willy McGinley was just 23 when he sadly passed away. His grave memorial was shattered by Sligo County Council without his family being informed. His grave was left in a terrible state, leaving his loved ones devastated by the heartbreaking discovery. We believe anti-Traveller prejudice and racism may have played a part. We demand an independent investigation, accountability and dignity and respect for Willy and his family.
attributes.background: Justice for Willy McGinley, who died aged just 23. His memorial was dismantled without his family being informed. We demand answers, an independent investigation into possible anti-Traveller discrimination, and the return of all memorial pieces. Every family deserves dignity and respect.

rejection.details: This appears to be something that occurred in a different country, namely the Republic of Ireland, for which the UK Government has no responsibility and over which it has no jurisdiction.
